SUPERSEDED by 3 split tickets (per user direction):

- 0ac3-dab8-abfd-4359: tests/scripts/test-write-cycle-ledger.sh intermittent (concurrent-write non-atomic assertion window) — original Track B
- 5e9e-852e-061f-4773: tests/scripts/test-gha-scanner-prompt-contract.sh SIGPIPE on echo|grep -q pipeline pattern — Track C
- cbf1-92cd-5d93-4bae: tests/scripts/test-dso-shim-subdir-dispatch.sh TIMEOUT >120s under MAX_PARALLEL=8 CPU contention — Track D

Track A (test-merge-to-main*.sh) was already closed by PR #221. The 3 remaining sub-tracks are independent root causes (race-window, SIGPIPE pipeline, CPU contention) that warrant separate triage, so the umbrella is dissolved.
